The annotators then judge which response is better from four aspects: (1) Style Consistency: which response exhibits the desired style more (2) Knowledge Preservation: which response is more relevant to the knowledgeable document (3) Context Coherence: which response is more coherent with the dialogue context (4) Fluency: which response is more fluent and free from any grammar errors.
